title.zh: 今天走一条从没走过的路回家
title.en: Take a path you've never taken home

prompt.zh: 打破日常路径，让熟悉的回家的路，长出一点新的部分。
prompt.en: Break your daily route. Let the familiar way home grow something new.

title.zh: 拍下一个让你停下来的颜色
title.en: Capture a color that stops you

prompt.zh: 不一定是漂亮的颜色，可能是某个被忽略很久的角落里，一抹让你愣一下颜色。
prompt.en: Not necessarily a beautiful color — perhaps one in a corner long ignored that makes you pause.

title.zh: 和你常去的那家店的老板说句话
title.en: Say something to the owner of a shop you visit often

prompt.zh: 不止是结账时的'多少钱'。可以问他们今天怎么样，或者夸一下他们做的东西。
prompt.en: More than 'how much'. Ask how their day is. Or compliment what they make.

title.zh: 拍一个你觉得可能很快就不在了的地方
title.en: Photograph a place that might not be here much longer

prompt.zh: 老的小店，旧的招牌，墙上斑驳的字。这些都在悄悄消失。
prompt.en: Old shops. Faded signs. Crumbling walls. These are quietly disappearing.

title.zh: 黄昏时分，抬头拍一张天空
title.en: At dusk, look up and photograph the sky

prompt.zh: 今天傍晚，整个城市一起做这件事。
prompt.en: This evening, the whole city does this together.

title.zh: 找一家从没进过的小店，进去逛一圈
title.en: Find a shop you've never entered and step inside

prompt.zh: 不必买什么。看看就好。
prompt.en: You don't have to buy anything. Just look.

title.zh: 记录你今天路过的三种纹理
title.en: Document three textures you walk past today

prompt.zh: 墙皮，砖纹，水迹，叶脉，铁锈。
prompt.en: Wall, brick, water stains, leaf veins, rust.

title.zh: 给一个陌生人一个微笑
title.en: Give a stranger a smile

prompt.zh: 不说话也可以。
prompt.en: Without a word is fine too.

title.zh: 拍下你家附近最老的一棵树
title.en: Photograph the oldest tree near your home

prompt.zh: 它比你早来很多年。
prompt.en: It was here long before you.

title.zh: 早上 8 点，记录你看见的第一个人
title.en: At 8am, document the first person you see

prompt.zh: 不需要拍脸，一个剪影、一个动作、一个距离都可以。
prompt.en: No need for their face. A silhouette, a gesture, a distance — all fine.

title.zh: 走过一座桥，看看桥下的世界
title.en: Cross a bridge and look at what's underneath

prompt.zh: 桥上和桥下，是同一个城市的两个故事。
prompt.en: Above and below a bridge — two stories of the same city.

title.zh: 找一处被青苔覆盖的地方
title.en: Find a place covered in moss

prompt.zh: 青苔只长在很久没动过的地方。
prompt.en: Moss grows only where nothing has moved for a long time.

title.zh: 问问身边最年长的人，这里以前是什么样
title.en: Ask the oldest person nearby what this place used to be like

prompt.zh: 他们记得的'附近'，可能和你看到的完全不一样。
prompt.en: The 'nearby' they remember may be utterly different from what you see.

title.zh: 记录一个老物件的现在
title.en: Document an old object as it is now

prompt.zh: 不必是收藏品，路边一个废弃的也行。
prompt.en: Not a collectible — something abandoned by the road is fine.

title.zh: 雨天里，拍一个被淋湿的世界
title.en: On a rainy day, photograph a drenched world

prompt.zh: 水珠、倒影、湿透的路面。
prompt.en: Droplets, reflections, soaked pavement.

title.zh: 沿着一条河走一段
title.en: Walk along a river for a while

prompt.zh: 每条河都曾是城市的命脉。
prompt.en: Every river was once a city's lifeline.

title.zh: 拍一张光影的形状
title.en: Photograph the shape of light and shadow

prompt.zh: 它们是时间最温柔的脚印。
prompt.en: They are time's gentlest footprints.

title.zh: 在公共留言板或墙上留下一个善意
title.en: Leave a kind note somewhere public

prompt.zh: 一张便签，一句鼓励，画一个小图案都行。
prompt.en: A sticky note, an encouragement, a small drawing — all fine.

title.zh: 记录一个一直在那里但没注意过的标志牌
title.en: Document a sign that's always been there but you never noticed

prompt.zh: 街名、店招、路牌，老广告。
prompt.en: Street names, shop signs, road plates, old ads.

title.zh: 夜里 11 点，拍一盏还亮着的灯
title.en: At 11pm, photograph a light still on

prompt.zh: 谁还在那里？他们在做什么？
prompt.en: Who's still there? What are they doing?

title.zh: 走到附近的最高点，俯瞰一下你的附近
title.en: Walk to the highest point nearby and look down at your neighborhood

prompt.zh: 从上看下来，熟悉的街会变得陌生。
prompt.en: From above, familiar streets become unfamiliar.

title.zh: 拍下一个被忽略的角落
title.en: Photograph an overlooked corner

prompt.zh: 不显眼，但一直在那里。
prompt.en: Not eye-catching, but always there.

title.zh: 把今天遇到的陌生人记下来（一句话就够）
title.en: Note a stranger you encountered today (one sentence is enough)

prompt.zh: 擦肩而过的，也是附近的一部分。
prompt.en: Those you brush past are also part of nearby.

title.zh: 找一家开了很多年的小店
title.en: Find a shop that's been open for many years

prompt.zh: 问问它几岁了。
prompt.en: Ask how old it is.

title.zh: 跟着一只猫或一只鸟走一段
title.en: Follow a cat or a bird for a while

prompt.zh: 它们知道的附近，和你完全不同。
prompt.en: They know a different nearby than you.

title.zh: 记录你今天路过的三种声音
title.en: Document three sounds you heard today

prompt.zh: 不必录音，文字描述就好。
prompt.en: No need to record — words are enough.

title.zh: 夸一个你今天遇到的人
title.en: Compliment someone you met today

prompt.zh: 可以是陌生人。
prompt.en: It can be a stranger.

title.zh: 记录一栋即将消失的建筑的影子
title.en: Document the shadow of a building about to disappear

prompt.zh: 拆迁围板已经立起来了。
prompt.en: The demolition boards are already up.

title.zh: 找一个能看见天空的角度（不开天窗的那种）
title.en: Find an angle where you can see the sky

prompt.zh: 抬头，是一种久违的姿态。
prompt.en: Looking up is a long-forgotten posture.

title.zh: 找一处被时间磨亮的地方
title.en: Find a place polished by time

prompt.zh: 被磨亮，是因为有人来来往往。
prompt.en: Polished bright because people came and went.
